title: D1330: rest at 1/17 HP with a scrawny cat two steps away
construction: Dwarf Paladin CL1, 1/17 HP, D1, on the up staircase. The death record gives the cause, HP and last action but no final observation; the cat at distance two and the stairs are constructed to reproduce the resting decision.
limits: A constructed state, not a recorded snapshot. The long-horizon assessment now sees the cat and the strategy leaves; with the staircase underfoot it ascends. The fixture does not claim the original death would have been avoided.
